senses.gloss: ch. same, to penetrate, to hollow out.
units: Ḥull. 119ᵇ חַלְחוּלֵי מְחַלְחֵל the hair perforates the skin.—Part. pass. מְחַלְחַל hollow; loosely filled.
<cite ref="Berakhot 59a:7">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>ענני חלחולי מְחַלְחֲלֵי</he> (Ms. F. <he>עיבא … מִיחַלְחַל</he>) the clouds are not entirely filled with water.
<cite ref="Pesachim 74a:2">Pes. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>איידי דמח׳</he> because the wood is hollow (having marrow inside); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be perforated, be open. Ber. l. c. Ms. F. v. supra.—Esp. to be permeated by poison, feel the effect of poison. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵃ bot.; Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ bot. לא אספיק … עד דאיתח׳ he had scarcely drank of it when he became affected (collapsed). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ top חמתה מִתְהַלְחֲלָה he saw that the plaster was poisoned.

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 97:4">Targ. Ps. XCVII, 4</cite>.
